name: Variety Show
description: We're gearing up for our upcoming Variety Show and need parent volunteers to help make it a success! Volunteer opportunities include Stage Hands and Concession Organizer. We are also looking for a volunteer who can provide a digital keyboard for the event. To Apply to the Variety Show, sign up using the link HERE. Important Dates: Audition Videos: Due by Sunday, March 1st, 2026, Dress Rehearsal: Thursday, March 19th, 2026 @ 4:00pm, Show: Friday, March 20th, 2026 @ 4:00pm

name: Multicultural Fair
description: This year's Multicultural Fair will take place on Friday April 24th from 4-7pm. A beloved tradition at this school, we once again invite you to share your culture with us, whether it's helping with your country's booth (or starting one if it isn't represented yet!), fashion show, or with a group cultural performance. Due to time constraints, solo and duo performances are encouraged to perform at the Los Alamitos Variety Show on March 20th (sign up by March 1st).

name: Reading Lab Volunteers Needed
description: The Reading Lab is a tutoring program for students who would benefit from extra help with fundamental reading skills. We are looking for volunteers who can come in once per week (Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday) during the school year. Training for new tutors is provided!! Helping these new & growing readers is super fun and rewarding! Volunteers must be registered with the district and approved by Los Alamitos.

name: 5th Grade Baby Photos Deadline
description: 5th grade parents — start gathering those adorable baby photos for the 5th Grade Baby Pages! They are due by March 31st! Please send them to your classroom parent yearbook rep and include your child's full name with the photo.

name: Yearbook Photo Upload Deadline
description: We are looking for photos from PTA events this year! If you have photos from the following events and would like them to be shared in the yearbook, please upload to these Google Drive Folders: Spirit Days, Dandy Day, Bubblefest, Science-o-rama, Dances. Please only upload 1-2 photos per event! Order your 2025–26 Yearbook today and save all the memories. Last day to order: 4/20 — but don't wait until the last minute! We won't have extras on hand if you forget to order.

name: Incoming 2025/26 Castillero 6th grade parents!
description: Castillero PTA is looking for incoming 6th grade parents to serve on the board. Castillero PTA funds and/ or runs events and programs like school dances, carnival, spirit wear, teacher and staff appreciation, and teacher grants. If you are interested in getting involved, please contact Stephanie Pearson-Phillips, (spearsonphillips@gmail.com or (650) 454-4389).

name: We Need You on the PTA Board!
description: We are looking for members of our Los Alamitos community to join our PTA Executive Board for 2026-27 school year! More details about specific positions will be shared soon, but if you're interested in getting involved, please email us or connect with any of our current board members. Serving on the PTA Executive Board offers a behind-the-scenes look at how our fundraising efforts work and provides a direct way to support and strengthen our school community.
